name: Calendar
description: A month of day buttons to pick one date, inline or in a popover (DatePicker). Six weeks so the height never jumps, one Tab stop with arrow keys, today ringed, the picked day filled, days outside min/max crossed out. Optional presets (Today, Tomorrow, Next week) and a footer for a time or a Clear button.

classes.ayy-calendar: Root: a column of the header, weekdays and grid, as wide as seven days (its content). Day size follows data-density.
classes.ayy-calendar--full: Fills its container's width (a phone screen, a bottom sheet); days grow up to 1.5× their size.
classes.ayy-calendar__presets: Row of quick dates above the month, in equal columns. role="group" with an aria-label ("Quick dates").
classes.ayy-calendar__preset: A quick date: <button data-date> with an icon over a short label. data-date is an ISO day or "+N" days from today ("+0", "+1", "+7"). aria-pressed="true" when it's the picked day.
classes.ayy-calendar__header: The month's title, then the two arrows at the inline end.
classes.ayy-calendar__title: "October 2026", with aria-live="polite" so a month change is announced.
classes.ayy-calendar__nav: Previous / next month button, with an aria-label and a directional arrow icon (so it points the right way in RTL).
classes.ayy-calendar__weekdays: Short weekday names over the columns, aria-hidden (each day button's label names its weekday).
classes.ayy-calendar__grid: The 42 day buttons, role="group" labelled by the month. One Tab stop: the picked day, else today, else the 1st has tabindex="0".
classes.ayy-calendar__day: <button data-date="2026-10-07" aria-label="Wednesday, 7 October 2026">7</button>. aria-pressed="true" picked, aria-current="date" today, aria-disabled="true" outside min/max, data-outside for the neighbouring months' days.
classes.ayy-calendar__footer: Under the month, after a hairline: a time input, Clear, Done.
classes.ayy-date-picker: The trigger, on a <button class="ayy-input">: a calendar icon and the date, styled like a field. Opens a popover with the calendar.
classes.ayy-date-picker__value: The date text inside the trigger. Empty shows its data-placeholder, muted.

states..ayy-calendar__day[aria-pressed=\"true\": The picked day: filled with the primary colour.
states..ayy-calendar__day[aria-current=\"date\": Today: a ring and a semibold number.
states..ayy-calendar__day[aria-disabled=\"true\: Before min or after max: dimmed and crossed out, focusable, not pickable.
states..ayy-calendar__day[data-outside]: A day of the month before or after: muted.
states..ayy-calendar__preset[aria-pressed=\"tru: The preset matching the picked day.
states..ayy-date-picker__value:empty: No date yet: the placeholder shows.

js: calendarMonth({ month, value?, today?, min?, max?, weekStart? }) → the 42 days to draw; calendarLabels(locale?) → { month, day, weekdays }; calendarKeyTarget(key, from, { weekStart?, rtl?, shift? }) → the day a key moves to; connectCalendar(root, { value?, min?, max?, weekStart?, locale?, onSelect? }) → { setValue, update, focus, destroy } draws and wires a month on plain markup. Date helpers on ISO days: addDays, addMonths, startOfMonth, startOfWeek, todayIso, parseIsoDate, toIsoDate, formatDate, localeWeekStart, resolveCalendarDate. calendarPreviousIcon, calendarNextIcon, datePickerIcon (SVG markup).

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-calendar: draws the month into its header, weekdays and grid (any month already in the HTML is replaced) and wires the arrows, the keyboard and the presets. In an <ayy-popover> whose trigger holds an .ayy-date-picker__value, it writes the date there and closes the popover when a day is picked.

attributes.value: The picked day, ISO ("2026-10-09"). Updated when a day is picked.
attributes.week-start: First column, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Default: the locale's.
attributes.locale: Language of the month and day names. Default: the browser's.
attributes.name: Form name: a hidden input inside carries the picked day.

events.ayy-select: { value } when a day is picked, value an ISO day.

props.value / defaultValue: string | null — the picked ISO day
props.min / max: string — ISO days; outside them days are crossed out
props.today: string — override today (tests, another time zone)
props.locale: string — month and day names. Default: the browser's
props.previousLabel / nextLabel: string — the arrows' accessible names. Default "Previous month" / "Next month"
props.presets: { label, date, icon? }[] — quick dates; date is ISO or "+N" days from today
props.presetsLabel: string — the presets group's name. Default "Quick dates"
props.footer: ReactNode — under the month (a time input, Clear)

DatePicker.renders: <button class="ayy-input ayy-date-picker" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with a Calendar

props.onValueChange: (date: string) => void — the popover closes after it
props.placeholder: string — shown while empty. Default "Pick a date"
props.format: (date: string) => string — the trigger's text. Default "7 Oct 2026" in the locale
props.name: string — a hidden input carries the ISO day

a11y: The grid is one Tab stop. Arrow keys move a day (mirrored in RTL) or a week, PageUp/PageDown a month (Shift: a year), Home/End to the week's ends; Enter or Space picks. Moving past the month's edge turns the page.
Every day button is named in full by its aria-label ("Wednesday, 7 October 2026"); aria-pressed says it's picked, aria-current="date" that it's today. The weekday row is aria-hidden.
Days outside min/max are aria-disabled, not disabled, so the arrows can cross them; they can't be picked. The title is aria-live, so a month change is announced.
DatePicker's trigger is named by its <Label htmlFor>; the date is its description. Opening it moves focus to the picked day; Esc or a pick returns focus to the trigger.
The picked day is a fill, today a ring and a heavier number; High Contrast fills the picked day with the system highlight.
do: Use a Calendar when the date is the main choice of a screen or panel: a due date with Today / Tomorrow / Next week presets, a booking, a habit's history.
Use DatePicker for a date field in a form: it shows the date like an input and opens the month on demand.
Set min (and max) instead of letting people pick days that can't work; say why in a FieldHint ("Arrivals from 3 pm").
Put a time input, Repeat or Clear in the footer rather than beside the calendar.
Use full in a bottom sheet or on a phone screen so the days are big enough to tap.
dont: Don't use a calendar for a birth date or any date far from today — a native <Input type="date"> (or three Selects) is faster to type.
Don't use it for a time alone — use <Input type="time">, or Choice cards (compact) for a few time slots.
Don't colour days by meaning (busy, free) without a second cue; put events in a list next to it.
Don't hide the arrows to fix the month; set min and max instead.
